name: Blox Fruits
about: Blox Fruits is a One Piece–inspired adventure where you level up, hunt Devil Fruits and fight bosses across three seas. Popular scripts focus on auto farm, fruit sniping and raids.

name: Grow a Garden
about: Grow a Garden is a farming simulator where you plant seeds, harvest mutated crops and trade pets. Scripts usually automate planting, selling and egg hatching.

name: Steal a Brainrot
about: Steal a Brainrot is a tycoon where you collect brainrot characters and raid other players' bases. Scripts commonly add auto steal, speed and base lock helpers.

name: 99 Nights in the Forest
about: 99 Nights in the Forest is a survival horror game where you keep the campfire alive and rescue lost children. Scripts typically offer auto chop, item bring and ESP.

name: Rivals
about: Rivals is a fast-paced competitive shooter with 1v1 to 5v5 duels. Scripts for Rivals usually include aimbot, silent aim and ESP.

name: Pet Simulator 99
about: Pet Simulator 99 is a collecting game where you break coins, hatch eggs and trade huge pets. Scripts focus on auto farm, auto hatch and event automation.

name: Brookhaven RP
about: Brookhaven RP is one of the biggest roleplay games on Roblox, with houses, vehicles and a whole town to explore. Scripts usually add trolling tools, fly and admin-style commands.

name: Murder Mystery 2
about: Murder Mystery 2 is a social deduction game with an innocent, a sheriff and a murderer each round. Scripts typically include role ESP, auto coin farm and knife aura.

name: Dead Rails
about: Dead Rails is a wild-west survival game where you drive a train across a zombie-filled desert. Scripts often add auto bonds, ESP and kill aura.

name: Fisch
about: Fisch is a fishing adventure with hundreds of fish, rods and islands to discover. Scripts commonly automate casting, reeling and selling.

name: Da Hood
about: Da Hood is an open-world street combat game. Scripts for Da Hood are known for aim lock, silent aim and auto stomp.

name: Arsenal
about: Arsenal is a classic gun-game shooter where every kill switches your weapon. Scripts usually include aimbot, ESP and gun mods.

name: Doors
about: Doors is a horror game where you escape a hotel full of entities, room by room. Scripts typically add entity notifications, ESP and auto-solvers.

name: Blade Ball
about: Blade Ball is a dodgeball-style game where you parry a homing ball with your sword. Scripts are known for auto parry and spam features.

name: The Strongest Battlegrounds
about: The Strongest Battlegrounds is an anime-inspired fighting game with combo-heavy characters. Scripts usually add auto combo, kill aura and dash tech.

name: BedWars
about: BedWars is a team PvP game where you protect your bed and destroy everyone else's. Scripts typically include kill aura, scaffold and long jump.

name: Jailbreak
about: Jailbreak is a cops-and-robbers open world with heists and vehicles. Scripts usually offer auto rob, vehicle mods and teleports.

name: Adopt Me!
about: Adopt Me! is a pet-raising and trading game. Scripts commonly automate pet tasks and money farming.

name: Tower Defense Simulator
about: Tower Defense Simulator is a co-op tower defense game against waves of zombies. Scripts usually include auto strategy recording and auto farm.

name: Bee Swarm Simulator
about: Bee Swarm Simulator is a long-running grinder where you collect pollen and grow your bee hive. Scripts focus on auto farm, auto quests and field automation.

name: Forsaken
about: Forsaken is an asymmetrical horror game where survivors try to outlast a killer. Scripts usually add ESP, auto generator and stamina helpers.

name: Ink Game
about: Ink Game is a squid-game style survival challenge with deadly minigames. Scripts usually help with Red Light Green Light, glass bridge and ESP.

name: King Legacy
about: King Legacy is a pirate RPG with fruits, swords and sea events. Scripts focus on auto farm, auto boss and fruit finders.

name: Universal
about: Universal scripts work in most Roblox games — admin commands, fly, ESP, speed and other tools you can run anywhere.
